title: Delightful Garlic Delight
description: A simple yet flavorful recipe perfect for a weeknight dinner. This garlic delight is easy to make and packed with flavor.

ingredients.name: kiddie delight
ingredients.notes: Note: If 'kiddie' is a type of vegetable, peel and chop it. If not, omit this ingredient.

instructions: Place the kiddie delight on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Toss to coat the vegetables evenly.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until tender.
